identificationModule.briefTitle: Programmed Death-1 (PD-1) Antibody Combined With Chemoradiotherapy in High-risk Recurrent Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: PD-1 Antibody Combined With Chemotherapy in High-risk Recurrent Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma: a Prospective, Open, Single-arm Phase II Clinical Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a a prospective, single-arm phase II clinical trial. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and adverse effect of PD-1 antibody with chemotherapy in high-risk recurrent nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

interventions.name: PD-1 blocking antibody
interventions.description: Toripalimab is an antibody targeting PD-1 developed by Shanghai Junshi Biosciences Co., Ltd.

primaryOutcomes.description: From date of recruitment to death

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: After 3 cycles of GP chemothrapy plus PD-1 antibody (each cycle is 21 days)
